Script 1 · “Week three”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“Here’s why so many budgets quietly die in week three.”

Body

“Most budgets are built for a perfect month. Then a birthday, a car repair or a random annual subscription shows up, and the whole thing feels broken. A spending plan expects those months. It’s a different way of planning, and it can be learned.”

CTA

“I’m teaching it live in a 60-minute masterclass. It’s $17 and the replay is included. Tap Sign up to grab your seat.”

Shot: talking to camera, natural light. On-screen text “week three”. End card: “Education only, not financial advice.”

Script 2 · “Where does it go?”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“Good income, but no idea where it all goes? That’s really common.”

Body

“It’s usually not one big thing. It’s lots of small, unplanned things. When every dollar has a job before the month starts, the leaks get easier to see and the plan gets easier to follow.”

CTA

“In The Money Nerd Reset I’ll show you how, step by step. Live, 60 minutes, $17. Tap Sign up.”

Shot: talking to camera, cut to a simple spending plan on screen with categories highlighted in gold.

Script 3 · “The money date”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“The people who stick to a plan all have one weekly habit.”

Body

“They don’t check their money only when something goes wrong. They set a short money date once a week: look at the plan, move a few numbers, done. It turns money from stressful into routine.”

CTA

“I’ll walk you through it in my live masterclass. Seats are $17. Tap Sign up below.”

Shot: talking to camera with coffee, cut to a 3-step checklist slide.

All ads and scripts are educational. They make no promises about income, savings, debt payoff or investment results.
